XLSX browser bundle notices
===========================

This directory accompanies the XLSX browser feature. Its ExcelJS notices
apply to the reviewed browser UMD identified by SHA-256:
7e49da68588e250dbb8bba190d2caa8ab3787cc0284bda1d8b2f805c4df742c9

The accompanying bundle-sbom.json is the authoritative bounded inventory and
records the source-map groups whose versions or license terms could not be
verified from this prebuilt artifact. It must remain with this notice.

The feature also uses fflate 0.8.3 (fflate/browser, MIT) as a separate ESM
dependency for export finalization. It is not embedded in the above UMD and
is not included in that artifact's bounded source-map inventory.

License attribution matrix
--------------------------

The source map proves that the following package groups are embedded. Their
specific build versions are UNKNOWN unless the SBOM states otherwise. The
license-family mapping below was checked against each project's public npm
registry metadata and, where available, an embedded source header. It supplies
the applicable license text without pretending that the registry's current
version is the UMD build input.

MIT: @fast-csv/format, @fast-csv/parse, asn1.js, base64-js, bn.js, brorand,
browser-pack, browserify, browserify-aes, browserify-cipher, browserify-des,
browserify-rsa, buffer, buffer-xor, cipher-base, core-js, core-util-is,
create-ecdh, create-hash, create-hmac, crypto-browserify, dayjs, des.js,
diffie-hellman, elliptic, events, evp_bytestokey, fast-csv, hash-base, hash.js,
hmac-drbg, lodash.escaperegexp, lodash.groupby, lodash.isboolean,
lodash.isequal, lodash.isfunction, lodash.isnil, lodash.isundefined,
lodash.uniq, md5.js, miller-rabin, minimalistic-crypto-utils, pbkdf2, process,
process-nextick-args, public-encrypt, randombytes, randomfill, readable-stream,
regenerator-runtime, ripemd160, safe-buffer, safer-buffer, stream-browserify,
timers-browserify, util, util-deprecate, uuid, xmlchars, plus pako above.

ISC: browserify-sign, inherits, minimalistic-assert, parse-asn1, saxes.

BSD-3-Clause: ieee754. sha.js is published as MIT AND BSD-3-Clause and is
therefore covered by both the MIT text and the BSD-3-Clause text below.

The minified source map itself additionally preserves these attributions:
Joyent, Inc. and other Node contributors (Node-derived portions in browserify,
core-util-is, events, readable-stream, stream-browserify, and util); Feross
Aboukhadijeh (buffer, safe-buffer, ieee754); Facebook, Inc.
(regenerator-runtime); Louis-Dominique Dubeau (xmlchars); and the Lodash,
Underscore, Dojo, and jQuery Foundation attributions in the individual Lodash
module headers. The exact source header remains the controlling attribution
where it is more specific than this summary.
